scripts.predev: node -e "try { require('fs').rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e) {}"
scripts.export: next build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.renameSync('out', 'dist'); console.log('Static export completed! Deploy the dist folder to cPanel.');"
scripts.clean: node -e "try { require('fs').rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('node_modules/.cache', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Cleaned!'); } catch(e) { console.log('Clean complete (or already clean)'); }"
